name: desk-bridge
description: GNOME Shell bridge extension of desktop-themes-rs (desk-bridge@desktop-themes-rs)
//: Two compilers on purpose. The build and the type check use TypeScript 7 (the native compiler, installed under the alias typescript-native and run by path because its bin name collides with the old one). typescript-eslint still needs the TypeScript 6 JavaScript compiler API (`require('typescript')`), which TypeScript 7 no longer ships, so `typescript` stays at 6.x and is used by eslint only. Drop the 6.x pin when typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
